scenarios.title: Employee table, then selected detail
scenarios.assertion: Identity-based data rendering and no data invented.

scenarios.title: Attendance ranking from raw schedule and observations
scenarios.assertion: Count employee-days with explicit approved-leave policy; no raw-log duplicate count.

scenarios.title: Fixed top-five population, then weekly trend
scenarios.assertion: Select population over full requested period before weekly trend; independent exact totals.

scenarios.title: Department ratio rollup
scenarios.assertion: Ratio of sums, not mean of employee percentages; missing pairs remain disclosed.

scenarios.title: AI-assisted derived meaning
scenarios.assertion: Validated draft and activation policy; same AST as manual path.

scenarios.title: Manual meaning builder/code round trip
scenarios.assertion: No string eval; dependencies/version/scope preserved.

scenarios.title: Unknown business meaning
scenarios.assertion: Definition flow or declared temporary hypothesis, never silent organizational truth.

scenarios.title: Desktop exact comparison to 320px/400% zoom
scenarios.assertion: Task-equivalent comparison remains possible; essential two-axis scroll permitted.

scenarios.title: Resize during IME/draft/drag
scenarios.assertion: Defer unsafe structure transitions; preserve focused owner and draft.

scenarios.title: Explicit table preference on narrow region
scenarios.assertion: Respect valid choice; report constraint conflict rather than silently swap.

scenarios.title: Large paginated population
scenarios.assertion: Bounded DOM, stable cursors, global versus page counts distinguished.

scenarios.title: Unrelated node patch
scenarios.assertion: Unrelated result/view subscriptions do not recompute unnecessarily.

scenarios.title: Out-of-order remote responses
scenarios.assertion: Old response cannot replace current result or resurrect closed region.

scenarios.title: Consumer unmount and reconnect storm
scenarios.assertion: Abort, listeners, caches, streams and workers released within policy.

scenarios.title: Join fanout
scenarios.assertion: Pre-aggregate or reject many-to-many fanout; no multiplied money/count.

scenarios.title: Missing dates, timezone/DST and calendar periods
scenarios.assertion: No last-known-value substitution; calendar months distinct from 90 days.

scenarios.title: Partial/approximate result
scenarios.assertion: Scope/error bounds presented; no global claim from sample or page.

scenarios.title: Units and exact decimal money
scenarios.assertion: Reject incompatible units/currencies; stable exact decimal calculation.

scenarios.title: Cross-tenant catalog/cache/cursor isolation
scenarios.assertion: No unauthorized metadata, counts, record IDs, result handles or stale access.

scenarios.title: Prompt injection in records/schema labels
scenarios.assertion: Treat content as data; no arbitrary code, endpoint or credential egress.

scenarios.title: Business action preview/confirm/revoke
scenarios.assertion: Recheck entity revision and authority at execution; no action from layout change.

scenarios.title: MCP versus direct versus BYOK parity
scenarios.assertion: Equivalent command produces same authorized state/receipt; real provider run labeled.

scenarios.title: Native WebMCP absent
scenarios.assertion: Manual/other transports work; no fabricated availability.

scenarios.title: Native WebMCP actual host
scenarios.assertion: Only real-host evidence allows native support claim; otherwise experimental/unverified.

scenarios.title: Vanilla zero-React consumer
scenarios.assertion: Actual packed/published-style tarball imports and interactive UI without React; stable registry verification is a later release gate.

scenarios.title: React/Next server render and hydration
scenarios.assertion: No model or browser globals during SSR, meaningful content and correct event/property mapping.

scenarios.title: Vue embedding of shared web component
scenarios.assertion: Same renderer, no second business logic or component implementation.

scenarios.title: Manual screen reader certification
scenarios.assertion: Deferred future certification; automated keyboard, focus, semantics, zoom and reflow remain release requirements and must not be represented as manual certification.

scenarios.title: RTL, locale, long labels and forced colors
scenarios.assertion: No clipping or color-only meaning; logical navigation remains coherent.

scenarios.title: Search and product comparison in app region
scenarios.assertion: Non-dashboard task preserves application navigation and region boundaries.

scenarios.title: Host-owned record edit form
scenarios.assertion: App action contract, draft/errors and explicit save; data mutation separate from view state.

scenarios.title: Unsupported source query
scenarios.assertion: Typed unsupported capability and useful alternatives; no full-dataset hidden fetch.

scenarios.title: Renderer throw/missing renderer
scenarios.assertion: Failed projection cannot produce a presented/completed receipt.

scenarios.title: Atomic region update concurrency
scenarios.assertion: Expected revisions, idempotency and conflict repair; no mixed partial presentation.

scenarios.title: Component inventory contract matrix
scenarios.assertion: Every release entry has standalone/semantic/region and applicable states evidence.

scenarios.title: Pre-release artifact skew and rollback rehearsal
scenarios.assertion: No npm overwrite; pinned old consumer works; deploy rollback does not require package deletion.

scenarios.title: Shared semantic definition revision
scenarios.assertion: Affected results invalidate intentionally; no uncontrolled loss of drafts or saved task meaning.

scenarios.title: Unseen domain/schema import
scenarios.assertion: Same contracts, new fields/metrics; no core domain enum or prompt phrase branch.

scenarios.title: Novel bounded composition without exact preset
scenarios.assertion: Combine existing capabilities without domain-specific pattern or core edits; required operations remain covered.

scenarios.title: Multigrain named outputs
scenarios.assertion: Ranking, weekly values and source detail have explicit dependencies and separate row grain.

scenarios.title: Presentation-only and form task
scenarios.assertion: No dummy query; reuse versioned results or form schema and keep writes separate.

scenarios.title: Evaluate without publishing every intermediate view
scenarios.assertion: Agent can investigate within budget while preserving incumbent UI; only intended results commit.

scenarios.title: Every dependency revision and principal scope
scenarios.assertion: Changed policy/catalog/profile/function/result/task epoch invalidates old proposal; unrelated new result need not.

scenarios.title: Unknown SSR and precision metadata states
scenarios.assertion: Known width requires value; estimated counts and approximate values require method and uncertainty.

scenarios.title: Claim grounding and changing population mix
scenarios.assertion: Correct totals do not permit incorrect all-groups/causal explanations; preserve evidence references.

scenarios.title: Structured AI composition proposal
scenarios.assertion: Registered nodes can be proposed; executable code, unknown schema and forged actor rejected.

scenarios.title: Typed selection versus filter/range/page/draft
scenarios.assertion: Separate payload schemas and compatible links, no arbitrary Json accepted as verified interaction.

scenarios.title: Canonical task ownership
scenarios.assertion: Leases cover actual src paths, no traversal or sibling-prefix collision; changing acceptance invalidates evidence.

scenarios.title: Budget exhaustion without false impossibility
scenarios.assertion: Bounded candidate generation reports exhaustion distinctly and reuses valid incumbent/fallback.

scenarios.title: Live versus fixed cohort on filter change
scenarios.assertion: Recompute membership only if task declares live population; stable cohort retains explicit lineage.

scenarios.title: Aggregate-only permission and model egress
scenarios.assertion: Server-approved aggregate visibility does not grant raw-detail or model data sharing rights.

scenarios.title: Post-publish registry and live identity
scenarios.assertion: Stable new package versions and immutable deployed image independently verified; prior consumer stays available.

scenarios.title: Hallucinated metric and renderer
scenarios.assertion: Unknown metric/view never produces a fabricated result or arbitrary renderer; correct gap with prior authorized state retained.

scenarios.title: Valid-but-wrong meaning
scenarios.assertion: Known metric selected for wrong latent intent is measured as semantic failure, not claimed prevented by schema; material known ambiguity gets a concise choice.

scenarios.title: Model score cannot authorize effect
scenarios.assertion: Changing model name or test score grants no read, UI, meaning, egress or business-write permission.

scenarios.title: Action needs host grant and confirmation
scenarios.assertion: experience.commit does not imply action.execute; forgedhuman/approval and stale confirmation fail every route.

scenarios.title: Weak model unavailable or looping
scenarios.assertion: Timeout/malformed repeated outputs preserve authorized state and manual controls; runtime-owned source-scoped fingerprints stop no-progress retries.

scenarios.title: Revocation invalidates old UI fallback
scenarios.assertion: Retaining previous UI on AI failure cannot retain data whose authorization was revoked.

scenarios.title: Narrative title grounding
scenarios.assertion: Numbers, titles and tooltips cite compatible result/time/unit; adding a source ID does not verify unsupported prose or causality.

scenarios.title: Low-risk default and meaning activation
scenarios.assertion: Known default disclosed; AI/manual same typeddefinition; session activation cannot silently overwrite organization meaning.

scenarios.title: Exact 0.1.0 identity collision
scenarios.assertion: Used name/version blocks publication; unavailable registry remains unknown. Unpublish does not free version.

scenarios.title: Lower semver release reset
scenarios.assertion: 0.1.0 is staged deliberately and documented as reset, not automatic upgrade from0.2/0.10; existing consumers and rollback preserved.

scenarios.title: Real docs and playground UI
scenarios.assertion: Component routes and snippet copies are specific and compiled; live preview uses actual package; agent inspector is secondary and keys server-side.

scenarios.title: Master traceability and extension boundary
scenarios.assertion: All discussion decisions map to current docs/tasks; generated images ignored; no-preset composition and new domain require no prompt-specific core branch.

scenarios.title: Developer code-defined meaning bootstrap
scenarios.assertion: Typed code/config reuses existing catalog, registers an authorized reviewed default without model/Studio, and end users reuse it without reauthoring or repeated approval.

scenarios.title: Code-owned definition validation and ownership
scenarios.assertion: Invalid references/units/grain rejected; same ID/revision with changed content rejected; exact repeat idempotent; Studio only reads/proposes diff, AI/session meanings cannot silently shadow repo definitions.

scenarios.title: Developer meaning DX and authoring parity
scenarios.assertion: External built-package example compiles with typed errors and schema reuse; code/Studio equivalent definitions share evaluator/results across views, no manual-path model calls or required Studio imports.
